text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—crosses the line in 1st place!
Brilliantly seizing the Grand Prix crown!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*...
*pant*...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Biggg siiiis!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Big siiiis, you were so great...!!
That was such a wonderful run!!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: Win next time, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Ines lost today, but still.
Her run was as great as ever."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Totally~. Seeing a run like that makes me feel like I can power through even my super boring part-time job tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've got some nerve doing that right in front of the store manager.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No! It's not like that,
it's on the level of making you wanna work hard at life~!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I get where you're coming from.
Her running really gives people energy, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Totally~. It kinda makes you want to chase after your own dreams for real, y'know?
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......Su-chan, Lu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...You carry a heavy burden too, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? Huh, Oguri-san!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ines, watching you run warmed my heart too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I felt warm all over, burning from deep within.
My heart screamed out
that I couldn't stay like this forever.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Let's meet again, Ines.
Right here in this place.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering the dreams of the people gathered here together,
let us race once more.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Carrying people's dreams"...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ......Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Keep running lots, okay? Both Sue and Lou...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I love you when you're working
so, so hard, Big Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Then can your big sister
ask for one favor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Su-chan, Lu-chan.
Will you keep helping your big sister from now on?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Can the two of you help out at home right now?
So that Big Sis can run in races here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you two?

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's run together with their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Let's keep running and having fun!
